findings.highlight: The thing that flies above the floor suddenly drops.
findings.evidenceJa: 地を走っていた“何か”が落ちる。
findings.governingReading: The “something” that had been running along the ground drops.
findings.explanation: A ground-running search effect becomes flight above the floor.

findings.highlight: The Berkana Rune finishes its search and turns back into a stone.
findings.evidenceJa: ベルカナのルーンを刻んだ小石は探索を終え、石くれに立ち返る。
findings.governingReading: The pebble inscribed with the Berkana rune finishes its search and returns to being an ordinary stone.
findings.explanation: The inscribed pebble becomes the rune itself, changing the spell’s physical subject.

findings.highlight: But there’s a bit more to the girl.
findings.evidenceJa: だが彼女の姿には、もう少しアクセントが加わっていた。
findings.governingReading: But her appearance had acquired a little additional “accent.”
findings.explanation: The sardonic indication of added physical harm becomes an unclear statement that there is more to the girl.

findings.highlight: You’regah!
findings.evidenceJa: おまえはぎゃっ！
findings.governingReading: You’re—gah!
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Shinji’s interrupted accusation with his cry.

findings.highlight: He didn’t kill the boy since it was unconscious.
findings.evidenceJa: 無意識だったので殺さずに済んだらしい。
findings.governingReading: Apparently Shinji escaped death because Lancer struck unconsciously.
findings.explanation: The grammar assigns unconsciousness to an undefined “it” and obscures why lack of conscious retaliation spared Shinji.

findings.highlight: He would have consciously tried to blow the boy’s head off given him appropriate retribution
findings.evidenceJa: その時は意識して、しかるべき報復をくらわせていたに違いない。
findings.governingReading: In that case he would consciously have administered the retribution Shinji deserved.
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents an attempted decapitation in a counterfactual that specifies only fitting retaliation.

findings.highlight: blow the boy’s head off given him appropriate retribution
findings.evidenceJa: しかるべき報復をくらわせていたに違いない
findings.governingReading: The Japanese supplies one coherent predicate: administer fitting retribution.
findings.explanation: An invented violent expansion and a closer rendering remain fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: The one walking past Matou Shinji is…
findings.evidenceJa: 硬い足音をたてて現れた人物は
findings.governingReading: The person who appears with hard footsteps, passing beside Matou Shinji, is—
findings.explanation: The sound and deliberate entrance staging of Kirei are omitted.

findings.highlight: We work together
findings.evidenceJa: 共に認め合った仲だが
findings.governingReading: We are partners who mutually acknowledge one another.
findings.explanation: Kirei’s deliberately absurd claim of reciprocal recognition with Shinji is omitted.

findings.highlight: I would not be so reluctant to do this if you weren’t so smart.
findings.evidenceJa: もう少し出来の悪い弟子ならば、惜しむ事もないのだが
findings.governingReading: Were you a somewhat poorer disciple, I would feel no reluctance to lose you.
findings.explanation: General quality as a disciple and Kirei’s ironic reluctance to discard Rin are narrowed to intelligence.

findings.highlight: He looks and sounds as though he’s giving a benediction to the dying.
findings.evidenceJa: 祝福するかのようなそれは、死に逝く者を看取る顔でもある。
findings.governingReading: The smile resembles a blessing, and also the face of one watching over someone as they die.
findings.explanation: Two superimposed facial images are collapsed into Kirei audibly administering a benediction.

findings.highlight: I have raised her to be my tool.
findings.evidenceJa: ここまで育てた大切な駒だ。
findings.governingReading: She is a precious game piece I have raised this far.
findings.explanation: Kirei’s possessive game-piece metaphor and mock value are reduced to a generic tool.

findings.highlight: That is why I ordered her protection.
findings.evidenceJa: おまえに彼女の警護を任せたのだ。
findings.governingReading: That is why I entrusted her protection to you.
findings.explanation: The specific entrustment of Rin’s protection to Lancer is erased.

findings.highlight: isn’t that more than enough to show my love?
findings.evidenceJa: 親心としては十分すぎるのではないかな
findings.governingReading: Was that not more than enough as an expression of parental feeling?
findings.explanation: Kirei’s grotesque parody of parental concern becomes an unqualified claim of love.

findings.highlight: You fraud.
findings.evidenceJa: エセ神父。
findings.governingReading: You sham priest.
findings.explanation: Rin’s targeted attack on Kirei’s clerical role becomes a generic accusation of fraud.

findings.highlight: He was my beloved teacher
findings.evidenceJa: 恩師であったからな。
findings.governingReading: He was my teacher and benefactor.
findings.explanation: “Beloved” invents affection in Kirei’s cold explanation that the trust of a former mentor made ambush easy.

findings.highlight: Even hell wouldn’t take a bastard like you!
findings.evidenceJa: 地獄だってアンタみたいなのは願い下げで、煉獄だって他の連中が図太くなるってんでタライ回しよ！
findings.governingReading: Even hell would refuse you, and purgatory would pass you around because your presence would make the others shamelessly tougher.
findings.explanation: The escalating hell-and-purgatory mechanism of Rin’s comic curse is cut in half.

findings.highlight: should lay on needles in hell
findings.evidenceJa: 性に合わない天国あたりで針の筵にくるまってろ
findings.governingReading: Go wrap yourself in a bed of needles somewhere unsuited to you, like heaven.
findings.explanation: The punchline condemning Kirei to ill-fitting heaven is reversed back into ordinary punishment in hell.

findings.highlight: The only ones who understand are the priest and the sacrifice, Tohsaka Rin.
findings.evidenceJa: おそらく、生け贄とされる遠坂凛本人だけだろう。
findings.governingReading: Besides the priest, probably only Rin herself—the intended sacrifice—understands.
findings.explanation: The narrator’s qualification of Rin’s understanding is promoted into certainty.

findings.highlight: she has no fear.
findings.evidenceJa: あまり恐怖はなかった。
findings.governingReading: She did not feel very much fear.
findings.explanation: A qualified degree of fear becomes its total absence.

findings.highlight: The master and the slave.
findings.evidenceJa: 主と従者。
findings.governingReading: Master and retainer.
findings.explanation: The relational term “retainer/servant” is intensified into literal slavery.

findings.highlight: His voice is a whisper now.
findings.evidenceJa: 漏れる声すら、もはや聞き取れない。
findings.governingReading: Even the voice leaking from him can no longer be made out.
findings.explanation: An unintelligible remnant of voice becomes an intelligible whisper.

findings.highlight: The spearmanLancer’s chest and heart are pierced by his own lance.
findings.evidenceJa: その心臓を完全に破壊していた。
findings.governingReading: his own spear has pierced his chest and completely destroyed his heart.
findings.explanation: The complete destruction of Lancer’s heart is weakened to its being pierced.

findings.highlight: The priest looks from the boy back to the girl.
findings.evidenceJa: ようやく、本命である少女を見た。
findings.governingReading: At last the priest looks to the girl who is his true target.
findings.explanation: The statement that Rin is Kirei’s main target is omitted.

findings.highlight: you have this wonderful side of you that admits reality.
findings.evidenceJa: 覆らない現実を瞬時に認めるのもおまえの素晴らしさだ。
findings.governingReading: Your excellence also lies in instantly recognizing a reality that cannot be overturned.
findings.explanation: Rin’s speed and exact acceptance of irreversible reality are omitted.

findings.highlight: A pierce.
findings.evidenceJa: ザクン、という音。
findings.governingReading: A wet, heavy stabbing sound.
findings.explanation: A concrete sound effect is replaced by the malformed noun fragment “A pierce.”

findings.highlight: Blood pours from his mouth.
findings.evidenceJa: 湧き上がる血液が、食道を逆流する。
findings.governingReading: Welling blood flows backward up his esophagus.
findings.explanation: The internal reflux through Kirei’s esophagus is reduced to blood leaving his mouth.

findings.highlight: the cursed lance that always strikes its target.
findings.evidenceJa: “貫くモノ”と称される呪いの槍
findings.governingReading: the cursed spear known as the “thing that pierces.”
findings.explanation: The local epithet is replaced by a different causal property of Gae Bolg.

findings.highlight: he turns to Lancer.
findings.evidenceJa: 背後に立ちつくすランサーへ視線を投げた。
findings.governingReading: he casts his gaze toward Lancer standing motionless behind him.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s position and stillness behind Kirei are omitted.

findings.highlight: because of his “dirty survival tricks”.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の“生き汚さ”故である。
findings.governingReading: because of his ugly, tenacious refusal to die.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s sheer undignified attachment to life becomes a set of unspecified survival techniques.

findings.highlight: A useless guy stayed useless, huh?
findings.evidenceJa: 役立たずは最後まで役立たずだったな、神父さん
findings.governingReading: Useless to the very end, weren’t you, Father?
findings.explanation: Shinji’s mocking clerical address is omitted.

findings.highlight: the boy kicks the priest’s head with all his might.
findings.evidenceJa: 少年は全力で神父の顔を蹴った。
findings.governingReading: the boy kicks the priest full-force in the face.
findings.explanation: The specifically degrading kick to Kirei’s face is generalized to his head.

findings.highlight: A heavy smacking sound echoes in the room.
findings.evidenceJa: ゴキン、と乾いた音が響く。
findings.governingReading: A dry cracking sound rings out.
findings.explanation: A hard, dry crack becomes a heavy smack.

findings.highlight: That must have pleased him, as the boy
findings.evidenceJa: それに満足したのか、少年は
findings.governingReading: Perhaps satisfied by that, the boy
findings.explanation: A narrator’s tentative inference about Shinji’s satisfaction becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: it’s pitiful to keep talking to a corpse.
findings.evidenceJa: 死んじゃったヤツにあれこれ言うのはみっともない
findings.governingReading: it is shameful to say this and that about someone who has died.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s hypocritical rule against speaking ill of the dead becomes a comment about addressing a corpse.

findings.highlight: beg me, Tohsaka.
findings.evidenceJa: 媚びてみろよ遠坂。
findings.governingReading: Try fawning on me, Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: Shinji demands submissive ingratiation; the English narrows it to begging.

findings.highlight: the one who can kill any heroic spirit
findings.evidenceJa: 最強を冠する英霊殺しのソレ
findings.governingReading: that Heroic-Spirit killer crowned the strongest
findings.explanation: The title of strongest is replaced by an unsupported universal ability to kill any Heroic Spirit.

findings.highlight: His voice sheepishly echoes through the room.
findings.evidenceJa: 声だけが虚しく響く。
findings.governingReading: Only his voice echoes futilely through the room.
findings.explanation: The futility of Shinji’s unanswered call becomes sheepishness.

findings.highlight: points it at Matou Shinji’s temple.
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二の眉間に合わせた。
findings.governingReading: levels it precisely between Shinji’s brows.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s exact central aim is moved to the side of Shinji’s head.

findings.highlight: At that instant, he falls.
findings.evidenceJa: 途端槍兵は、力無く崩れ落ちた。
findings.governingReading: At once the spearman collapses without strength.
findings.explanation: The physical depletion revealed by Lancer’s collapse is omitted.

findings.highlight: Lancer’s limbs are already dead.
findings.evidenceJa: 槍兵の手足はとうの昔に死んでいるのだ。
findings.governingReading: The spearman’s limbs have been dead for some time already.
findings.explanation: The duration emphasizing that the rescue exceeded an already failed body is weakened.

findings.highlight: killed his master
findings.evidenceJa: 主を貫き
findings.governingReading: pierced his Master
findings.explanation: The specific impossible act performed with the spear becomes generic killing.

findings.highlight: A heart pierced by my lance won’t heal easily.
findings.evidenceJa: オレの槍で破壊された心臓は簡単には治らん。
findings.governingReading: A heart destroyed by my spear cannot be healed easily.
findings.explanation: Complete destruction of the heart is weakened to piercing.
